meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: 它把聊天渠道和 AI 助手分组接起来,能查看哪些渠道已接通、哪些还没接,新接入渠道时设置会话隔离级别,也能把渠道改绑到其他助手分组,并给出配置总结。
howto.when: 当你在添加了一个聊天渠道之后、处于配置阶段、或想重新调整渠道与助手分组的接法时,Claude 会处理这部分配置。

say.text: 帮我看看现在哪些渠道已经接通,哪些还没接。
say.note: Claude 会查询数据库,把渠道分为已接入/未接入两类。

say.text: 把 Telegram 群 123456 接到新助手分组,用独立会话。
say.note: Claude 会先确认隔离方式,再走配对流程。

say.text: 把 Slack 的 #general 改绑到另一个助手分组。
say.note: 旧会话留在原分组,新消息进新分组。

howto.what_en: Claude can inspect channel wiring: query DB, categorize channels as wired/configured-but-unwired/unconfigured, wire new channels to agent groups, choose isolation levels, add channel groups, move existing wirings, and print a config summary.
howto.when_en: Use it after adding a channel, during initial setup, or standalone when the user wants to reconfigure how channels map to agent groups.

say_en.text: Show me which channels are connected and which aren't yet.
say_en.note: Claude queries the DB and lists channels by status.

say_en.text: Wire Telegram group 123456 to a new agent group with isolated sessions.
say_en.note: After choosing isolation, Claude runs the pairing flow.

say_en.text: Move #general on Slack to a different agent group.
say_en.note: Old sessions remain; new messages go to the new group.
